THE CUBE LENS

The Deck's Geometry, Looked Through
THE WAYFINDER THE MAP ROOM THE RING THE RESONANCE THE INSTRUMENT THE LANGUAGE THE ASTROLABE THE ROSETTE THE SPECTRUM THE WORKSHOP

The deck is the affine space of three dimensions over three elements, and the living cube is the body that geometry already had. This lens slices it and lights what the geometry hands over: thirteen lines, thirteen planes, four body diagonals, and the cube's own census. Everything shown is derived. Nothing here is cast, and no letter appears. Touch a card to hold it as the shared focus. See THE SPINE.
